messages:
maya: Heads up — Snowflake + Databricks connector pilots are greenlit, but we need to align marketplace listing timeline and the vector DB joint docs. Can we sync on go/no-go dates?
liam: Thanks — quick Q: are we gating on the Qdrant/Milvus packaging or the Snowflake external table example?
sofia: Both, ideally. Marketing wants a single announcement that mentions connectors + vector DB partners + a hardware reference, not three smaller posts.
ravi: From eng side, the blocker is the streaming ingest test harness — we need a reproducible sample dataset and an automated e2e test. I can prioritize if timeline is locked.
maya: Target audience is platform SIs and Marketplace buyers. Proposed announce week: Apr 22. Is that feasible for engineering?
liam: Apr 22 is tight. If we cut a few nonessential demo flows (e.g., onprem bundle), we can make it. Need final test plan by Apr 8.
ken: I'll own the announcement checklist + partner signoff doc. @sofia — can you draft the joint messaging outline by Apr 5? Marketing needs quotes. :memo:
sofia: Yep, will draft. Also want a short customer-facing matrix: "which connector for which workload".
ravi: For the e2e harness I'll use the sample dataset from the retail pilot but need permission to share sanitized slices with partners. Legal ok?
maya: @ken to confirm partner NDAs. Also tagging marketplace-bot to check listing windows.
marketplace-bot: FYI — submission deadline for Marketplace featured release slot is 2024-04-12. Late submissions go into next cycle (2-week lag).
liam: OK that forces schedule: test plan by Apr 8, partner packaging by Apr 10, submission by Apr 12. Can we do a soft launch internally Apr 19?
sofia: Soft launch works. Also can we prepare two short demos: 1) fast vector search in Snowflake via connector, 2) Databricks notebook + vector DB indexing. Keep each ~3 min.
ravi: I'll own demo #1 artifacts and automation. @liam will you help with connector perf numbers (latency / tokens / cost estimates)?
liam: Yep — I'll run perf runs on the dedicated pool and share a short table.
ken: For partner handoff: we need legal signoff, co-marketing assets, and a technical contact for SI enablement. @maya can you confirm partner points of contact?
maya: Confirmed: Snowflake -> Priya, Databricks -> Marco, Qdrant -> Elena, Milvus -> Jorge, SI lead -> Tasha. I'll DM the list and add to the doc.
sofia: Any hardware partner mentions? We can include one line: "validated on Aurora/GPU nodes" but only if hardware packaging doc is in place.
liam: Hardware folks shared firmware diff yesterday — low risk. If we mention it, include a note "subject to region availability".
ken: Action items recap (I'll update doc): Apr 5 messaging draft (Sofia), Apr 8 test plan (Ravi), Apr 10 packaging & partner signoffs (Maya/Ken), Apr 12 marketplace submission (Ken), Apr 19 internal soft launch, Apr 22 public announcement.
ravi: I'll post the test checklist here by EOD tomorrow. Small ask: need a sample SQL snippet for Snowflake consumer facing doc.
liam: Quick snippet for Snowflake connector usage: `CREATE INTEGRATION redwood_vector FOR EXTERNAL FUNCTION ...` — I'll paste full example in the doc.
sofia: Great — once the draft is up I'll loop in partners for quote approvals. :sparkles:
maya: Thanks team. If blockers surface, flag asap in this thread or ping me directly.
ken: Noted. I'll schedule a 30-min sync next Tuesday to verify readiness.
marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: marketplace submission precheck runs nightly. Use /marketplace precheck <bundle-id> to validate assets.
liam: One more thing — let's include a short A/B experiment plan to measure conversion from listing to trial. I can sketch variant metrics tomorrow.
sofia: Love that — add to the post-launch ops checklist.
maya: Closing loop — I'll share the partner signoff doc link when live. For now, thanks and moving to action items. :white_check_mark:
